data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for AppDynamics mobile real‑user monitoring and analytics.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the native AppDynamics SDK to capture network requests, crashes, screen views, custom metrics and user interactions. Provides APIs for manual instrumentation and automatic data collection.
use_when: You need AppDynamics RUM in a Flutter app
You want automatic crash and ANR reporting
You require network request tracking integrated with AppDynamics
avoid_when: You prefer a free/open‑source analytics solution
You only need basic logging without a commercial backend
strengths: Comprehensive coverage: network, crashes, screens, custom metrics
Supports both Android and iOS with native permissions
weaknesses: Limited to AppDynamics; not a generic analytics library
Setup involves native Gradle and manifest changes
data.setup_notes: Add AppDynamics Gradle plugin and apply 'adeum' in android/app/build.gradle; add INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions; configure AgentConfiguration in Dart before runApp.

alternatives.name: sentry
alternatives.why_pick_it: Open‑source crash reporting and performance monitoring without a commercial license

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Flutter‑specific Sentry integration offering similar crash and performance features
